title: Sequential task learning with reward-modulated temporal eligibility; jitter data-overlap correction
status: Local preregistration before the corrected final seed run. Pilot seeds 998-1001 are excluded.
correction_note: Compared with v0.28, this run only changes jitter test-generation acceptance to reject exact overlap with training inputs. Model, learning hyperparameters, primary train/test examples, and seed list are unchanged.

protocol.jitter_label_policy: accept only perturbations that preserve the original label; reject jitter inputs that exactly overlap any training sequence
protocol.test_overlap_policy: exact event-sequence overlap between train and IID/shifted/jitter test is forbidden; final runner aborts on train/jitter overlap

limitations: Local hash freeze, not an independent external timestamp.
Reservoir fixed in this phase; only readout synapses learn.
Reward-modulated timing eligibility is a simplified computational abstraction, not full biological STDP.
